sources.bonus_mapping: XEW/XComGame/Config/DefaultGameCore.ini, ItemBalance_Classic block under "Starter, Country and Continent bonuses". eItem 0 = starting bonus, 1 = country bonus (active while that country has satellite coverage), 2 = continent bonus (needs full coverage). iTime is the bonus id, iEng its value. The same block applies at every difficulty.
sources.names_and_descriptions: XEW/XComGame/Localization/INT/XComStrategyGame.int, ContinentBonusNames[id] and ContinentBonusDesc[id]; <XGParam:IntValue0> in the description is filled with the config value.
sources.countries: TCountry structs on XGCountry actors in the save (iEnum is the country id used by the config). Starting cash per country from the "Initial Cash Amounts" block of the ini, before the difficulty multiplier.
sources.effects: Bonus effects are implemented in the game scripts; the description text is what the game shows.

save_fields.continent_bonus: XGContinent.m_eBonus (vanilla EContinentBonus enum name, one per continent; Long War reuses these slots for its own bonuses)
save_fields.starting_bonus: not stored by name; the game keeps the starting country and derives the bonus from the config
save_fields.country_bonus: not stored; a country bonus is active while XGCountry has a satellite
